name: Mahinda (Buddhist monk)
role: Indian Buddhist monk and son of the Mauryan emperor Ashoka
contribution: An Indian Buddhist monk depicted in Buddhist sources as bringing Buddhism to Sri Lanka.

checks.lead: Mahinda (Sinhala: මිහිඳු මහරහතන් වහන්සේ) (285 BCE – 204 BCE) was an Indian Buddhist monk depicted in Buddhist sources as bringing Buddhism to Sri Lanka. According to Sri Lankan tradition, he was a Mauryan prince and the first-born son of Emperor Ashoka from his first wife Queen Devi, and the older brother of Princess Sanghamitra.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
